settings.file_path.label: File Path
settings.file_path.description: Absolute path of the file to read
settings.refresh_interval.label: Refresh Interval (ms)
settings.refresh_interval.description: How often to re-read the file. Minimum 100 ms.
settings.text_color.label: Text Color
settings.font_family.label: Font Family
settings.font_family.description: Font family name (leave empty to use the bar default)
settings.max_chars.label: Max Characters
settings.max_chars.description: Maximum number of characters to display. Text longer than this will be truncated with an ellipsis. Set to 0 for no limit.
